draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Karaikudi! It's the biggest city in Sivaganga district and the heart of the Chettinad region. Karaikkudi Junction is the main railway junction for all of Chettinad.
draft.hungryLine: You're in Chettinad country, so ask locals where to find a proper home-style meal nearby.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Kattuthalaivasal is a 5 min walk, with its Jamia Masjid as the local landmark.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take a slow wander through the Kattuthalaivasal neighbourhood and see the Jamia Masjid.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Karaikudi only became a municipal corporation in 2024.

spots.name: Kattuthalaivasal
spots.detail: 5 min walk · Neighbourhood with the Jamia Masjid, renovated in 2005

spots.name: Karaikkudi Junction railway station
spots.detail: Short drive · Main rail-head for the whole Chettinad region

tips.title: Base yourself here for Chettinad.
tips.body: Karaikkudi Junction is the major rail junction of the Chettinad region, so it's an easy jumping-off point.

tips.title: Dress modestly at the mosque.
tips.body: If you visit the Jamia Masjid in Kattuthalaivasal, cover up and follow local customs.

story.title: Chettinad's big town
story.body: Karaikudi grew into the largest city in Sivaganga district and the centre of the Chettinad region.

story.title: A renovated mosque
story.body: The Jamia Masjid, the main landmark of Kattuthalaivasal, was renovated in 2005. The area grew busier when it got a new bus stand.

story.title: Picked for renewal
story.body: Karaikudi was chosen as one of the cities for development under the national AMRUT urban scheme.

story.title: A new corporation
story.body: The Karaikudi Municipal Corporation was set up in 2024. The railway junction is also lined up for an upgrade under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme.
